summary: 1 blocking finding remains and will be repaired: R3 and acceptance criteria must require file-map entries for every testable requirement, not only requirements with diff coverage.

items.title: Instruction scope is narrower than the gate's file-map requirement
items.target: R3 / Acceptance Criteria ("every testable requirement with implementation or test diff coverage")
items.rationale: The finding matches verified validation behavior. validateFileMap requires entries for every requirement where testable !== false, so the spec must not instruct agents to skip testable requirements without judged diff coverage.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[2].desc and acceptance_criteria[2] contain the narrower phrase. src/flow/lib/test-artifacts.js validateFileMap builds expected from requirements.filter(r => r.testable !== false) and rejects missing entries.
